audit_items.proof_trace: cToken 'transfers' between obligations use only Sui's Balance.split/join operations (ctoken_table.move join_ctoken/split_ctoken), which are Supply-neutral by Sui framework design and do not touch reserve.total_supply. The only two functions that modify total_supply are increase_ctoken_supply (called exclusively in mint_ctokens on deposit) and decrease_ctoken_supply (called in burn_ctokens on withdraw and liquidate_ctokens on liquidation); exhaustive grep confirms no other call sites exist. The Supply object is stored in a module-private ReserveBalance dynamic field and is inaccessible to external callers.
